theme_and_colors.notes: Natural luxury - restrained. The primary background should always be a warm, organic Ivory, not pure white. Use Deep Forest Green for primary actions and strong typographic contrast. Terracotta should be used sparingly as an accent for call-to-actions, badges (e.g., 'Best Seller'), and interactive states.

typography.notes: Headings must use Cormorant Garamond for a premium, photography-driven natural luxury aesthetic. Inter provides sterile, clean legibility for dense e-commerce UI like product specs and ingredients.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous whitespace. Let the premium photography breathe.

grids.catalog: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:gap-8

spacing_and_layout.surface: Flat solid surfaces for product cards. Avoid heavy box-shadows. Use delicate 1px borders (border-border/60) with subtle background tinting on hover.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or softly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast. Primary uses Deep Forest Green, Secondary uses Terracotta.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic preferred for product grids (image + text below without explicit card borders). Use subtle background fills for ingredient/transparency panels.
components.header: Solid Ivory or Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/80) with a delicate bottom border. Do not use fully transparent headers over hero images to preserve navigation readability.
components.cart_drawer: Slide-out cart using Sheet component. Minimalist lines, clear line-item breakdowns.
components.ai_assistant: Floating widget in the bottom right using a Terracotta icon. Chat window should feel like a premium concierge service, grounded on product data.

hero_and_mood.description: Lush forest nature view, suitable for brand mood or 'Our Story' section background.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Apply 'Natural Luxury - Restrained' visual direction. Override default shadcn variables with the specific Ivory/Forest Green/Terracotta theme provided.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Integrate Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond for all headings, Inter for body text.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build a robust PDP (Product Detail Page) with a Transparency Panel featuring an accordion for ingredients, nutrition, and certifications.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build a single-page accordion checkout flow that feels premium and frictionless, avoiding multiple page reloads.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement a seamless Cart Drawer (using shadcn Sheet) rather than a cart page.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add a floating AI Assistant chat widget anchored to the bottom right. The AI chat UI should be styled elegantly, perhaps with a soft Ivory background and Deep Forest Green text.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Ensure mobile-first catalog layout defaults to 2 columns on mobile, expanding up to 4 columns on desktop.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Create the admin dashboard to manage catalog, orders, and CMS. Use denser 'Inter' typography and tighter grid layouts here to prioritize data density and function over spacious aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Deep Forest Green text over Ivory background meets WCAG AA standards. Add focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-secondary focus:ring-offset-2) to all interactive elements.
accessibility.semantic: Use proper HTML5 semantic tags (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <footer>) for layout.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='product-title').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and thoughtful negative space.
Use generous padding (e.g., py-24 for sections) and whitespace. Cramped designs look cheap.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-full or elegantly restrained borders) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use professional SVG icons (e.g., Lucide).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided curated Unsplash images.
DO NOT use a fully transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content scrolling under it.
